build.reason: The recipe names a static CMake build, but the supplied packet does not include the CMake defaults needed to resolve XML_CONTEXT_BYTES or establish every compiled route.

input.reason: The entry passes the fuzzer's byte buffer to XML_Parse; XML_Parse validates argument form and returns an error for rejected arguments. No changed behavior requires a different input protocol.

lifecycle.reason: Creation and freeing are visible, but the odd-size reset path cannot be fully assessed because XML_ParserReset's body was not supplied.

control_flow.reason: For every parser, the only nonfinal parse occurs with a fresh partial-token counter; the next parse is final and bypasses the new deferral check.

accepted.requirement: Exercise the default-enabled reparse deferral skip for a partial XML token by making a subsequent nonfinal parse call on the same parser before finalization.
accepted.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates each parser, then ParseOneInput calls XML_Parse once with isFinal=0 and once with isFinal=1; XML_Parse reaches callProcessor directly or through XML_ParseBuffer.
accepted.failure_condition: The first call starts with m_partialTokenBytesBefore=0, so its doubling condition is satisfied. The second call sets finalBuffer and bypasses the deferral guard. No target parser receives the later nonfinal call needed for the skip.
accepted.alternative_paths: The namespace and external-entity parsers repeat the same two-call pattern. Reset occurs only after those calls and no parser is reused afterward. The separate parse-buffer fuzzer is a different target.

harness_evidence.quote:
for f in ../fuzz/xml_parse_fuzzer.c ../fuzz/xml_parsebuffer_fuzzer.c; do
  [ -f $f ] || continue
  b=$(basename $f .c)
  $CC $CFLAGS -DENCODING_FOR_FUZZING=UTF-8 -I../lib -I. -c $f -o $b.o && \
  $CXX $CXXFLAGS $b.o -o $OUT/${b}_UTF-8 $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $LIB
